hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/hills-creek-state-park/stay ('Many sites with electric; some full-hookup sites (sewer, water, electricity)') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880109 (the Full-Hookup sites list 50-amp, water and sewer; 19 of 22 Modern Electric sites list 50-amp, 3 list 30-amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: '85 sites at the north end of the park'. The booking site lists 72 RV-capable sites (35 Modern Non-Electric, 22 Modern Electric, 15 Full-Hookup) plus 8 tent-only sites, cabins, cottages and yurts. Listed max vehicle lengths run 18-96 ft; most non-electric sites take 30-40 ft, and the Full-Hookup sites mostly 50-96 ft. Three are pull-through (12, 16, 47).

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hills-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880109 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Firewood/ice concession in the campground; the booking page lists the nearest laundromat as outside the campground (it lists both a food concession/store in the campground and the nearest camp store outside it). Glamping (Timberline, 8 sites) arrives in 2026.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/hills-creek-state-park/stay (Amenities: 'Warm showers, Flush restrooms, Water fountains, Sanitary dump station') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880109 ('Nearest Laundromat Outside Of Campground'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hills-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880109 (Booking Window for Full-Hookup, Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to mid-October) already manual. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 15 full-hookup sites, 72 RV sites to 96 ft with 3 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump/water fountains, no laundry. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs; camp store left unset (booking page says both). Fees left as recorded (statewide table).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (weak): stored 'not waterfront'. ReserveAmerica lists 'Proximity to Waterfront: Less than 300 feet' and 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Less than 300 feet' on 11 Full-Hookup sites (Loop A 18-22, 24, 25; Loop B 47-50), e.g. site 049 at 41.813486,-77.197404. Under 300 ft is not frontage; check those pads against Hills Creek Lake.
